fixed.summary: A model fading in, an HLOD cross-fade, a model's level cross-fade and a scattered copy crossing to its impostor are cut by one dither (interleaved gradient noise turned with every drawn frame, the clock TAA's jitter turns by) instead of three: a scattered copy's crossfade used its own blue-noise tile and the reveal turned by the scene clock. A capture draws the same pattern whatever was drawn before it.
